about_item: Human-grade dog bed: The orthopedic dog bed features a 6" thick base excluding the headrest. The foam design is contracted from a 3-layer, 4-inch base (30D) + 1" memory foam + 1" eggshell foam infused with cooling gel. Creating a comfortable raised dog bed.

Vet Approved: Our dog beds cradle the bone structure posture, helping to relieve pressure, ease arthritis pain, joint inflammation, and other ailments, especially beneficial for older dogs and larger breeds.
Key features: Cooling dog bed, foam remains stable in warm or cold climates. Waterproof dog bed comes with 2 covers, an inner and an outer, both washable and removable.
Size: Meticulously sized for all breeds, cat, puppy to giant jumbo dogs, small dog bed medium size dog bed large sized dog bed, & XL dog bed we have you all covered.
Note: Upon initial unboxing the foam may appear compressed. Rest assured that it will regain its original shape within 24-72 hours.

authors_reviews.title: Very satisfied customer
authors_reviews.text: After taking this out of the box I was so amazed on how big it was! It was the perfect size for my Great Dane to sprawl out on and be completely comfortable. As soon as I took it out of the box it started expanding and my Dane wanted to hop on it right away! Lol. She was very eager to try it out. This bed is extremely comfortable has a thick mattress and I even tried it out and its more comfortable than my own and I'm kind of jealous haha. It has a comfortable velvet cover that's washable...I haven't washed mine yet so I am unsure as to how well it holds up. I do catch my Dane sometimes trying to dig at the bed as she's always trying to make a nest with the bedding but she's doing better about it so we will see how well it holds up with her. Overall I'm impressed. Great price, great quality, comfortable, A+ in my opinion and the shipping was super quick!
authors_reviews.author: Chelsie

authors_reviews.title: Best dog bed and affordable
authors_reviews.text: I recently purchased the Noah & Paw orthopedic dog bed for my pup, and I’m genuinely impressed with the quality and comfort. As soon as I set it up, my dog climbed on it and pretty much claimed it as her new favorite spot. The foam support is excellent — it’s firm enough to keep her joints elevated, but still soft and cozy for daily lounging.The cover has a premium, velvety feel and blends nicely with home décor. It’s removable and machine-washable, which makes cleaning really convenient. For extra protection, I added a thin waterproof pad underneath the main cover just to keep the foam pristine, and everything fits without affecting comfort.The bed holds its shape really well and doesn’t sag when my dog shifts around. The height is perfect so she doesn’t have to struggle to get on and off, and it’s large enough for her to stretch out comfortably, even with toys around.Overall, this bed feels high-quality, supportive, and thoughtfully made. My dog naps, plays, and lounges on it throughout the day — which says everything. Definitely worth it for anyone looking for long-term comfort and joint support for their pet!Highly recommended. 🐾
authors_reviews.author: Hemant

Take Good Care of your Old Dogs… Don’t waste time & money on the other dog beds ( like I did ) My dog of 14 years APPROVES this.. and when she finally reaches that rainbow bridge I could honestly say I did the best for her comfort …because of people like Noah & Paw -again thank you for creating a wonderful world where pets can live..

authors_reviews.title: Fantastic Bed for Giant Dogs
authors_reviews.text: I am absolutely thrilled with this bed for my mastiff! He is aging and has some orthopedic issues, and this bed has been amazing for him. The XXL size is large enough for him to spread out, and he likes having the option of using the headrest.Despite the foam being thick and supportive, it doesn't make him overheat. It is firm, doesn't dent, and expanded to full size almost immediately out of the box.Assembly was a breeze, the cover is easy to wash, and the price is fantastic for this level of quality. These beds are so awesome I bought two... and I might even buy another, haha!On top of a great product, the customer service from Noah & Paw has been phenomenal and incredibly responsive. Highly recommend for anyone with a giant breed dog!
authors_reviews.author: Trisha
